name: pianotalk
description: Let Claude read what you played on your digital piano and play phrases back on it.
long_description: PianoTalk lets Claude read the takes recorded from your MIDI piano (notes, chords, timing, pedals) and play phrases back on the piano. Recording is done by the PianoTalk recorder, which you set up separately; see the README. macOS only.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List recordings, newest first (date, length, note count, range, kept flag)

tools.name: get_recording
tools.description: Read a recording as text: notes and chords in time order, with timing, velocity and pedals

tools.name: play_notes
tools.description: Play a phrase on the piano and save it as a .mid file

tools.name: keep_recording
tools.description: Keep a recording so it is never auto-deleted

tools.name: delete_recording
tools.description: Move a recording to the Trash
